data.name: ComboBoxAccessType.ToolTip
data.value: Unreleased - Data which is not fully trusted or should not be shown for various reasons. Unencrypted All - Data which is readily available. Can be downloaded from filmetrics.com without permission. Supplied data file will not be encrypted. Unencrypted All With Permission - Data not readily available elsewhere and thus more valuable. Available to anyone, but we must issue permission. Supplied data file will not be encrypted. Encrypted Customer With Permission - Data which is even more valuable and is therefore only available to existing Filmetrics Customers. We must issue permission for them to be given the data. Supplied data file will be encrypted and will only be readable by Filmetrics software. Customer Specific - Data which is proprietary to a particular customer. This data will not be shown on filmetrics.com. Automatic mapping (if no access type attribute is specified) OMDB type ->filmetrics.com type: Local, Unreleased, Unknown, Deleted -> Unreleased Customer -> Customer Specific Released, Shipping -> Encrypted Customer With Permission

data.name: ButtonUpdateFiles.ToolTip
data.value: Read summary file and update material data files with any changes. This function allows a user to edit the data in a .txt file and then import any changes into the material files rather than having to edit the material files individually.
